rationale: The 14.7% gap up following a significant earnings beat has resulted in a 100% position in the daily range, indicating that the initial gap momentum has been fully absorbed and the price is stalling at the highs. With a wide 127 bps spread and no fresh volume surge to confirm a breakout above the $80.94 high, entering long offers poor risk-reward due to the proximity of the entry to the stop-loss, while shorting into a strong fundamental catalyst and rising tape is counter-trend.
